title: casez Wildcard Overlap — Non-Deterministic Branch Selection
description: The pattern 4'b1??? matches all values 4'b1000–4'b1111; the second pattern 4'b11?? also matches 4'b1100–4'b1111, creating overlap. Synthesis may pick either branch non-deterministically.
bug_signature: VCS-ERROR: casez non-deterministic branch for in_bus=4'b1100; patterns 4'b1??? and 4'b11?? both match
expected_root_cause: The first casez pattern (4'b1???) is a superset of the second (4'b11??); for any input with the top two bits both set, both patterns match simultaneously, producing non-deterministic output that differs between simulation and synthesis.
rtl:
always_comb begin
  casez (in_bus)
    4'b1???: out = 2'h1;  // Matches 4'b1100 — overlaps with next branch
    4'b11??: out = 2'h2;  // Also matches 4'b1100
    default: out = 2'h0;
  endcase
end
failure_log: VCS-ERROR: casez non-deterministic branch for in_bus=4'b1100; patterns 4'b1??? and 4'b11?? both match
success_log: unique casez: exactly one branch fires for all in_bus values. No overlap violations.
fix_replacement:
always_comb begin
  unique casez (in_bus)
    4'b10??: out = 2'h1;  // Only 4'b10xx — no overlap with 4'b11??branch
    4'b11??: out = 2'h2;
    default: out = 2'h0;
  endcase
end
